title: Server backup
description: Everything on this server in one encrypted backup: the panel's own state, a dump of every database and the files of every volume. Each run sends only what changed.
enabled: Back up this server every day
enabledHint: The first backup starts within a minute of turning it on.
destinationHint: An S3-compatible destination, or this server's disk. Add one under Storage.
timeHint: Every day at this time, in UTC.
keepDailyHint: The last backup of each of these days.
keepWeeklyHint: The last backup of each of these weeks.
keepMonthlyHint: The last backup of each of these months. 0 keeps none.
sameDisk: This destination is on this server's own disk: it will not survive the loss of the server.

key.title: Recovery key
key.created: Keep this key outside this server, in a password manager. Without it, no backup can be read, even by you.
key.kept: I have kept it somewhere safe
key.revealHint: Prove it is you: your two-factor code, or your password if your account has none.

status.title: Last backup
status.started: The backup has started. Follow it under Activity.

restore.title: Rebuild this server elsewhere
restore.intro: Keep three things outside this server: the recovery key, this repository and the destination's access keys. On a new server, the commands below put everything back: accounts, projects, volumes and databases, then deploy what was running.
restore.command: On the new server, as root (sudo -i first):
restore.keys: read waits for the recovery key, pasted without being shown. The access keys are the ones entered for this destination under Storage.
restore.local: This repository is on this server's own disk: copy it to the new server first, then give its path there.
restore.guide: Every step, and how to pick an older backup, is in docs/BACKUPS.md, “Restore a whole server”.
restore.running: This server is being brought back from the backup of {{host}} taken {{when}}. Follow it under Activity.
restore.succeeded: This server was brought back {{finished}} from the backup of {{host}} taken {{when}}.
restore.failed: This server was brought back {{finished}} from the backup of {{host}} taken {{when}}, except for:
